page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a dedication title in centred lines. Below it, a salutation line and the opening paragraph with a woodcut initial Q, in full width. At the foot, a signature mark at left and a catchword at right. A red library stamp sits in the right margin and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: BARONI de LEUTH, MEYSWYK & EYSDEN &c. Domino
specimina, à nobis pro viribus illustrata,
& cum historiis, ad rerum praedictarum implemen-

page.notes: The title block is one level-1 head. Its small capitals are written as capitals. "zu" and "FLODORFF" are in black letter and marked <bl>. The surname "FLODORFF" is doubtful and marked [?]. The "o" in "Praeposito" looks like a Cyrillic-style letter in the scan. It is probably a plain o, so it is copied as printed. The woodcut initial Q is joined to "uod". The red stamp is excluded. The signature "* 2" is a gathering mark. The catchword "tum" is kept outside the text, and the paragraph ends on the hyphenated word "implemen-" as printed.
